# Euroanswer

> Euroanswer is a boutique BPO (business process outsourcing) company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Romania. It provides multilingual customer service outsourcing, technical support and staffing services in 20+ languages from delivery centres in Romania, North Macedonia and Uzbekistan, with additional delivery from Ukraine, Poland and Hungary, serving clients in 40 countries. Euroanswer is ISO 9001 and ISO/IEC 27001 certified and GDPR-compliant.

Key facts:

- Founder & CEO: Marian Raianu
- Founded: 2004
- Headquarters: Romania (registered office: 28 Dr. Iacob Felix St, 1st Floor, 011038, District 1, Bucharest)
- Delivery centres: Romania, North Macedonia, Uzbekistan
- Other delivery countries: Ukraine, Poland, Hungary (other EU countries possible depending on requirements)
- Languages: English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Dutch, Romanian, Greek, Hungarian, Finnish, Polish, Czech, Slovak, Bulgarian, Macedonian, Albanian, Serbian, Russian, Turkish, Arabic
- Industries: technology, banking, financial services, gaming, education, booking & travel, personal advertising, digital printing
- Certifications: ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 27001 (certification body accredited by IAS)
- Contact: office@euroanswer.co.uk, +40 317 305 000

## Services

- [Customer Service Outsourcing](https://www.euroanswer.co.uk/customer-service-outsourcing/): omnichannel multilingual customer support (phone, email, chat, social media), customer experience, complaints management, technical help desk, back office
- [Staffing Services](https://www.euroanswer.co.uk/staffing-services/): recruitment, HR administration, payroll and outstaffing (staff leasing)
- [Services overview](https://www.euroanswer.co.uk/services/)
